prompt: Audit of post-demo sales leave-behind one-pager

assertions.text: Content type is correctly identified as 'one-pager' or 'leave-behind'
Output uses the structured format: CONTENT TYPE, OVERALL SCORE, SCORECARD, FINDINGS, NARRATIVE ARC, GAP MATRIX, TOP 3 PRIORITIES
'Relocation Made Easy' or equivalent tagline is flagged as wrong register (lifestyle/consumer)
'all-in-one' is flagged as generic SaaS filler
'seamless', 'best-in-class', and 'intuitive' are flagged as forbidden phrases
'Real relocations, not demos' is identified as a defensive qualifier
Missing problem statement / problem stakes section is called out as a structural gap
The CTA (email address only) is flagged and a more specific CTA is recommended
